rows.note: The web-e2e tests run in Chromium and WebKit. The paste chords are the browser's own (the dispatcher leaves them to the editor): the test dispatches the paste event the browser delivers, with its text, and the editor inserts it at the caret as one undo step, CR LF and CR as line breaks, a tab kept as a tab with Real Tabs off (editor-ui 8.7). Paste from the menu, toolbar and context menu asks navigator.clipboard.readText while the click's user activation lasts and inserts the answer (given by the test, as Safari gives it after its Paste callout); refused, it shows the toast of note 45. The real system clipboard is shown in Chromium only by "Cut, Copy and Paste with the keyboard move text through the clipboard" (not named here: Playwright grants the clipboard in Chromium alone) and in Safari by the manual checks P2, P3.
